message: 二人の距離は縮まって

name: Synn
message: 「Crap... Did I fall asleep just like that...?」
Really, if even I end up dozing off, that's just pathetic.
For some reason, Macaron's coat was draped softly over my shoulders while I was fast asleep.

name: Synn
message: 「I could've sworn I put this over Macaron...」
I look around the room, but the coat's owner is nowhere to be seen.
So this coat really was Macaron's lifeline against the cold.

name: Synn
message: 「You put the coat over me, didn't you, Macaron?」

name: Macaron
message: 「When I noticed, you were fast asleep... so I thought, 'Ah, he's gonna catch a cold'...」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm glad you worried about me, but it defeats the purpose if you end up catching a cold instead.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Besides, you did all the work for me partway through, so I felt bad waking you up...」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. Sorry for making you walk on eggshells.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ugh... You really should've been the one to catch a cold instead!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's my fault for being careless. Sorry.」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'll thank you for fixing my coat, at least...」

name: Synn
message: 「I told you, don't worry about that.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ah, I have to go to my part-time job...」

name: Synn
message: 「No way. You need to stay in your room and rest quietly today.」

name: Synn
message: 「If you go in that condition, you'll just make everyone worry.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll let them know you're taking the day off.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Yeah... okay. I'll be good and rest.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Just watch. I'll kick this cold in no time!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, that's right. Just had a lot going on.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, it's been cold lately, so it can't be helped.」

name: Synn
message: 「I told her to stay in bed all day today, so I think she'll be fine, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「Please don't lump her in with you, Nanaka.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't talk about me like I'm not human!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If we're talking about that, Mako-chan's literally a Demon, isn't she.」

name: Synn
message: 「Human or Demon doesn't matter when someone's sick.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, right. That's just the kind of guy you are.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm gonna go check on her for just a second before we head out.」

name: Synn
message: 「Macaron, I'm heading off to the academy now, so--」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa! Hey, what are you clinging to me for! You need to stay in bed!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nooo, nooo! I don't wanna be alone, I was lonelyyy!」
When she looks up at me with puppy-dog eyes like that...

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm not letting go until you say you'll stay with me.」
I guess even Macaron gets anxious sleeping all by herself.
It's not like I can call the demons from the Warusaders to come nurse her either...
I'll dedicate all of today to Macaron.
Not because she asked me to.
It's because I want to do it for her.

name: Synn
message: 「Then wait right here for a bit. I'll be right back.」
I could've sworn I left Alzard right by her bedside...
For some reason, it's sticking straight out of the wall.

name: Macaron
message: 「Uwaah... Moving so suddenly made me all dizzy...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Big brother said he'd stay with me...」

name: Macaron
message: 「W-well, I know it's not really a good thing to do... but...」

name: Macaron
message: 「At a time like this, it's okay to be a little spoiled, right...?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sounded pretty noisy in there, everything okay?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gotcha. Well then, shall we get going?」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... sorry, Nanaka. I'm taking the day off today.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh? What're you talking about, the Student Council president playing hooky?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not it. I'm taking care of Macaron while she's sick.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even so... ah, well, I guess there's no other roommate you could ask, though...」

name: Synn
message: 「Either way, I can't just leave her alone.」

name: Synn
message: 「I wouldn't joke about something like that.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If you're going that far to say it, there's no stopping you.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'll make up some excuse for the teacher on my end.」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry for putting you through the trouble.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't mention it. I'm worried about Mako-chan too, after all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, make sure you take good care of her!」

name: Synn
message: 「You really do understand this kind of thing best, Nanaka. It's a huge help.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Heh? Ah, hahaha! Well, we have known each other a long time, after all!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Though if Misa or Helena-san give you grief later, don't look at me.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「See ya. I'll stop by again in the evening.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Geez, you took forever! Where did you go?」

name: Synn
message: 「I didn't go anywhere. Come on, I told you not to get up.」

name: Synn
message: 「Here, lie flat on your back properly.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Are you gonna start playing doctor or something?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Wha--!? Hey, wait a second, you pervert, Big Brother!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Taking advantage of me while I'm weak... *cough, cough*」

name: Paqy
message: 「Right now you could do whatever you want to her and she wouldn't be able to fight back.」

name: Synn
message: 「Be quiet in front of a sick person, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe I'll use Paqy to make an ice pillow.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then here, let me give you a wet towel. Show me your forehead.」

name: Synn
message: 「You mustn't move until your fever goes down.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Then make sure you keep a close eye on me, Big Brother.」

name: Synn
message: 「What am I gonna do with you~」

name: Macaron
message: 「Still, being nursed like this really makes it feel like I've caught a cold.」

name: Synn
message: 「You don't just feel like it, you actually caught one.」

name: Macaron
message: 「I've hardly ever had anyone do this for me before...」

name: Macaron
message: 「...Neither Papa nor Mama ever did stuff like this for me.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Because right now, Big Brother is taking care of me like this!」

name: Synn
message: 「...Do you have an appetite? I'll go make you something.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Mhm... Then I'll leave it to you, Big Brother!」

name: Synn
message: 「Though I can really only make something like rice porridge.」
I get to do something for Macaron.
Just that alone makes me feel kind of happy, or maybe proud.

name: Paqy
message: 「What's this, you're in a pretty good mood, aren't ya.」

name: Synn
message: 「When I think about how it's for Macaron, it just happens naturally.」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, if Macaron gets better, it makes me happy too.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I can vouch for the taste.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, be careful, it's hot. I'll cool it down for you now.」
One scoop with the soup spoon.

name: Macaron
message: 「I can do at least that much myself, *cough*」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, just leave it to me.」

name: Macaron
message: 「It's fine, I'll do it myself. Fwoo.」

name: Macaron
message: 「B-Big Brother, your face is too close...」

name: Synn
message: 「Aah, sorry, I just got a little carried away, ah no, not with your face, Macaron, um.」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, I said I'd do it.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Mmph, even though I told you it's fine...」

name: Macaron
message: 「I am, but that's a little different.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Besides... today, the Demon Lord is taking a day off.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Catching a cold just means I still haven't trained enough...」

name: Macaron
message: 「And besides, I can only do this kind of thing at times like this...」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, I don't really get the training part, but resting is definitely important.」

name: Synn
message: 「Right now, you need to get plenty of rest and recover from your cold.」

name: Synn
message: 「And then, I want to see your usual energetic smile again soon.」
Maybe I should change her towel.

name: Synn
message: 「Your fever still hasn't gone down, has it.」

name: Synn
message: 「I hope it gets better before it gets any worse.」

name: Synn
message: 「You can go to sleep. I'll stay right here.」

name: Synn
message: 「You already took your medicine, ate your food, and you're resting, right......」
Of all times, the reliable Great Sage is nowhere to be seen.

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe passing it on to someone else?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Then, can I pass it on to you, big brother?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, if it'll make you feel better, Macaron, I don't mind......」
If I can take on her suffering for her, that wouldn't be so bad.
I lean in closer to her bedside.
I bring my face nearer so I can catch even her faint voice.
Close enough to peer right into her glazed, feverish eyes.
Macaron's arms reach out smoothly, gently pulling my head in--
With Macaron's feverish, soft lips, like a relative of cherries.
Secret nectar as sweet as milk captures the two of them and pulls them close.

name: Synn
message: 「...I-If we do it maybe one more time, it might...」
Deep inside his chest, a suffocatingly sweet pleasure swirls, swallowing up the flickering sense of immorality.
His mind is completely tangled up, able to see nothing anymore except the dewy temptation right before his eyes.
Even so, at this rate, something like Macaron's fever feels like it will transfer in no time.

name: Synn
message: 「...Next time, I feel like I'm definitely gonna catch it...」
Leaning deeply over Macaron as she lay on her back...

name: Misa
message: 「Macaron-san, how are you feeling... oh, my?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn... what do you think you're doing?」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha?! A-Ah! This is, uh, yeah, nursing her!」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, look, like passing the sickness mouth-to-mouth--they say a cold goes away if you give it to someone else, right?!」

name: Synn
message: 「I figured I'd try out all sorts of things I can do! Right, Macaron?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Leaning right over a sleeping Mako-chan--just what were you planning to do~?」

name: Misa
message: 「Caught completely red-handed. There's no talking your way out of this!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Uuu... *sniff*, I'm so disappointed in you, Synn-kun...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I don't really understand, but you're under arrest!」

name: Synn
message: 「L-listen to what I have to say...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Of course. We'll let you explain yourself in full...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So, in other words, you didn't have any dirty thoughts at all.」

name: Synn
message: 「...I'm sorry, I had just a little.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Honestly, you... Even when joking around, there's a line between what's okay and what's not.」

name: Synn
message: 「What happened earlier was a misunderstanding and an accident, and I've got all kinds of excuses for that, but...」

name: Synn
message: 「I didn't fall in love with Macaron as some kind of joke!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Synn, cut it out with the weird jokes...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is it not a wonderful thing to come to love someone? I am quite fond of your little sister myself.」

name: Misa
message: 「I don't think that's the kind of 'love' we're talking about here...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No way, you're lying... I mean, Synn...」

name: Ria
message: 「...If those are your true feelings, Synn-kun, I'll support you.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Indeed. I see no reason whatsoever to take offense either.」

name: Misa
message: 「W-well, romance is up to each person's own tastes, right? As long as you don't make any mistakes in broad daylight...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hm, mistakes? Then what sort of act would be the correct answer?」

name: Misa
message: 「Th-th-that's, you know, after you become an adult, um, well... mumble mumble...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I guess I'm just not good enough after all...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hahaha... The fact that you haven't even noticed means I wasn't even in the running, huh...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Having it hit me right to my face hurts more than I thought...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then, as your childhood friend, I'll cheer you on, Synn.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Since you're saying that, you don't intend to do things halfway, right.」

name: Synn
message: 「I fell in love with Macaron as a person, as a single girl.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Go say those embarrassingly cheesy lines directly to Mako-chan!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I get it already! When you like someone, you just can't help it!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So go love Mako-chan with everything you've got!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Jeez... Without even knowing how I feel...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I really am way too soft-hearted, or just plain stupid...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, moping around and looking pathetic isn't really my style...」

name: Misa
message: 「Are you sure you're okay to be up already?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Mmm... I slept quite a bit, so I feel a little refreshed.」

name: Ria
message: 「Still, they say the recovery stage is crucial, so you should rest a little longer.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Yeah... but I'm all sweaty and feel gross...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't tell me you're letting her use *that*」

name: Synn
message: 「Macaron has money from her part-time job, so she usually goes to the public bathhouse.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, right. Yeah, of course she does.」

name: Misa
message: 「You haven't fully recovered yet, so I think it would be better if you just wiped yourself down instead.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Besides, I want to change my clothes too...」

name: Ria
message: 「Then how about we help you out?\s07」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, indeed. If there is anything we can assist with, please don't hesitate to ask.」

name: Macaron
message: 「It's fine, I can do it by myself...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn can't exactly help you get changed or wipe you down, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well then, sorry to trouble you guys, I'll leave it to you.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now, now, go ahead and take those clothes right off.」

name: Ria
message: 「How's the hot water and towel, not too hot?」

name: Misa
message: 「U-Um, do you think I could maybe try it on, just for a tiny bit...?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hand the clothes you took off over here.」

name: Ria
message: 「Aha, your underwear is super cute, Macaron-chan.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In that case, I won't lose out either!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, no, you don't need to strip, Lolo-chan.」

name: Ria
message: 「Alright then, I'll start wiping you down.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then allow me to wipe down this side for you.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Awuuun, come on, I said it tickles, hya, ah, afuh.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. I shall diligently serve every nook and cranny♪」

name: Macaron
message: 「Th-That's enough, I'll do the rest myself...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What's the matter~? Your voice is starting to melt~?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ah, nn, ahaa, th-that's good, it feels so good...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ufufu, you're finally being honest with yourself.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What're you gonna do if it gets worse.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... Looks like you were tripping on some naughty delusions.」

name: Paqy
message: 「When just on the other side of a single door, the little squirt is stripped naked and getting felt up all over his body...」

name: Synn
message: 「First I go and do that to Macaron, and on top of that...」

name: Synn
message: 「I need to cool my head! I'm gonna go for a quick run!」

name: Misa
message: 「Yelling at the top of his lungs... What on earth is he doing...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hm...? What the--here I thought it was a piece of dried squid, and it's just Paqy.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Are you playing floor rag in a place like this?」

name: Macaron
message: 「...Big Brother really did say he likes me...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ah, b-but I only happened to overhear him today, I haven't heard it directly from him yet.」

name: Macaron
message: 「So I haven't lost! Yeah, it's a tie!」

name: Macaron
message: 「How am I supposed to tell him...」
Why does it feel so hard to breathe...?
